source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 5, Theorem 5.6 and Corollary 5.7; Proposition 5.8; Propositions 5.3--5.4; Assumptions 1, 4, and 5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5.6 assumes d_max=o(n^(1/9)); Corollary 5.7 gives Wald coverage under that condition; the direct-effect nonconvergence sequence is Proposition 5.8; Proposition 5.3 gives normalized additive variance-bound error and Proposition 5.4 gives ratio consistency; the fourth-moment and non-superefficiency assumptions match the core's class conditions.
The paper supplies Berry--Esseen-type Kolmogorov bounds for sums with a dependency graph under L_delta moment conditions; it does not analyze CGD's ordered desired-exposure construction.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association, published online 13 May 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article characterizes admissible conservative quadratic variance bounds under interference and complex designs, rather than a CGD-specific uniform ratio or CLT frontier.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct every CGD locator, especially Proposition 5.9 to Proposition 5.8, and state that the variance comparison is against Propositions 5.3--5.4 rather than a single pointwise-consistency proposition.
Make the quantitative normal-approximation theorem explicitly name the martingale inequality and display how each of its two normalized error terms produces the stated degree exponent.
Add a corollary identifying a graph family beyond repeated stars where the new frontier is materially less restrictive than the published o(n^(1/9)) rule.

recommended_next_step: Correct the CGD proposition citation and then advance this field-tier, otherwise well-scoped proposal to Stage 0 for the promised coordinate-flip audit.
